notes.title: RUSSIAN VILLAGE SIMULATOR 2 GAME ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Hello, dear friends!
-We have released Russian Village Simulator on Mars! 

And this means that on the basis of new mechanics we will be able to realize the long-awaited continuation of Russian Village Simulator and continue the story of Ivan! 
[previewyoutube=6900dj5MC2g;full][/previewyoutube]
-You wrote a lot in our communities asking for a continuation of this idea and now this day has come!
We have noticed that some people don't like our Mars theme very much, so you didn't have a chance to enjoy the new project in full.
-We listened carefully and decided that our new project will be SRD2! 
It will be relevant, for those people who have not played the Russian Village Simulator on Mars. 
-The stylistics of the game will be strikingly different from this idea and will return to the original source.
-All those who played Russian Village Simulator on Mars will be able to enjoy: new locations, old music, characters, the atmosphere of the last game. The quests will remain from Mars, but will undergo significant changes and will reflect Ivan's story. 
Thank you for your support! Thanks to you our project becomes better and more interesting. 
We do everything according to your requests and wishes!
The release of the project is scheduled for May 27 2025 year.
